_source: VICE binary-monitor cpuhistory (an absolute cycle stamp per instruction) over 300 live frames per board with the enemy clock unfrozen ($0CE5 cleared). Each pass is attributed by JSR/RTS depth; a delta above the opcode's own minimum by 20 or more is a VIC badline steal and is removed, as are the interrupt handlers, so every figure below is play-loop CPU cycles unless named _wall. Boards ls9795 (8 enemies), ls0335 (7), ls0042 (2).

rotation_redraw_1f9f._what: update_object_on_screen $1F9F, inclusive, the redraw a $1805 rotation forces

rotate_parts._what: the fixed callees of $1805, inclusive; constant across all 16 rotations

irq._what: wall cycles, the 7-cycle interrupt entry included, measured on ls9795

cooldown_130c._what: $130C inclusive, (cycles, bytes that decremented, loop iterations); 21 is the no-carry frame, 33 the $0C50 gate decrement, the rest the 24-byte walk

pass_segments._what: the four sub-pass segments of one $1289 pass, inclusive, ls9795, 632 passes: head $1289..$129F, the $16B5 body up to $16D6, $16D6..$16E5 (prnd + cursor), and $12A2..$12C7 with and without the $191F it calls

frame_boundary_segment._what: which segment of the pass the raster IRQ interrupted, read off the $95E9 stack frame at $9630 over 1500 live frames per board

frozen_idle_rate._what: clock frozen ($0CE5 bit7 set, so $9659 skips BOTH $130C and $1635) and every enemy gate shut: $1289 hits counted off a silent VICE checkpoint over 3000 video frames, beside passcost.idle_pass_cycles of the seed image. frames * (FOREGROUND_CYCLES - IRQ_GATE_SHUT - SOUND_TICK_IDLE) / pass_cycles must reproduce passes
